sentences.text:
Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Avanindra Kumar Singh
 On The 12th Of August, 2024

Rajkumar Rai
 Versus
 Dharamveer And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Abhishek Verma - Advocate for the appellant.
 Shri T.S. Lamba - Advocate for the respondent No.3.
 Order
It is submitted that in M.A.C.C. No. 35/2021, learned M.A.C.T., Banda, District Sagar vide award dated 23.06.2023 for property loss has awarded a compensation of Rs. 6,000/-.

Learned counsel for the respondent Insurance Company submits that maximum coverage under the Policy for property loss in this case was Rs.6,000/-, which has been paid by the Insurance Company as per Section 147 of the Motor Vehicle Act.

Learned counsel for the appellant fairly admits that as per Section 147 of the Motor Vehicle Act,
maximum coverage was Rs.6,000/- which has been paid, therefore, after hearing learned counsel for the parties this Court is of the considered opinion that no further ground remains in this appeal for admission and subsequent adjudication.
Accordingly, this appeal is disposed of.
(AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE 2 MA-5667-2023 VSG Rajkumar Rai vs Dharamveer on 12 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135537082/
